election: 2025 Swiss Federal Council election (to succeed Viola Amherd)
role_sought: Member of the Swiss Federal Council
detail: Elected by the United Federal Assembly. In the first round Pfister received 122 votes to Ritter's 105 (absolute majority 123), forcing a second round, in which Pfister won 134 votes to Ritter's 110. Pfister was widely seen as the outsider against the favourite Ritter.

role_sought: Member of the Zug Executive Council (Regierungsrat)
detail: Elected in a by-election to fill the vacancy left by Peter Hegglin; subsequently took over the cantonal Health Department.

role_sought: Member of the Zug Executive Council (Regierungsrat)
detail: Re-elected to the Zug government; reported to have won the most votes of any candidate despite having to defend the canton's COVID-19 measures as health director.
